title: NSWP look, inline
description: How a person looks, in the short form that travels in an arrival context and between the members of a room: a seed, and only the parts that differ from what the seed generates. This schema is structural. A part with a value that isn't on its list is not an error: a reader keeps the generated part and carries on. See protocol/05-looks.md.

s.description: The seed: stands in for a key.
